predicate_semantics: Conjunction of two fully-derived terms. (1) kernel["EdgeType"]=="ShiftPtr": EdgeType defaults to ShiftPtr (Solution.py:4993) and is overridden to "None" only when enableTDMA and enableTDMB are both True (Solution.py:4994-4995), where enableTDMA=bool(TDMInst&1), enableTDMB=bool(TDMInst&2). (2) enableEdge: local bool initialized False (KernelWriterAssembly.py:16790); set True if (not (BufferLoad and GuaranteeNoPartialA) and BiasSrc=="A") or (not (BufferLoad and GuaranteeNoPartialB) and BiasSrc=="B") (lines 16794-16797). GuaranteeNoPartialA = (not TLUA) or (AF0EM%GRVWA==0) (Solution.py:4570-4573); GuaranteeNoPartialB analogous with AF1EM/GRVWB/TLUB (Solution.py:4575-4578). All inputs are validated YAML solution/problem params (TLUA/TLUB are layout-derived bools); no runtime/object/filesystem/gpu state.

z3_encoding.domain: And(Or(TDMInst==0,TDMInst==3), Or(AF0EM==1,AF0EM==4), Or(GRVWA==1,GRVWA==4), Or(AF1EM==1,AF1EM==4), Or(GRVWB==1,GRVWB==4), Or(BiasSrc==0,BiasSrc==1,BiasSrc==2))

derived.enableTDMB: TDMInst >= 2   # valid for seeded {0,3}; models bit1 of TDMInst

z3_encoding.note: Bounded discrete domain (all vars enumerable). bias_src enum mapped to ints. TDMInst seeded as {0,3} so the enableTDMA&enableTDMB=True (EdgeType=None) corner is NOT reachable inside this seeded domain: TDMInst=3 -> enableTDMA & enableTDMB -> EdgeType=None, but 3 also sets both bits; TDMInst=0 sets neither. Hence within the seed, edge_is_shiftptr is True iff TDMInst != 3. The TRUE/FALSE witnesses below both use TDMInst=0 (EdgeType=ShiftPtr) and toggle enableEdge.

z3_model_output.true_model: [TDMInst=0, BufferLoad=True, AssertFree0ElementMultiple=1, GlobalReadVectorWidthA=4, AssertFree1ElementMultiple=1, GlobalReadVectorWidthB=4, ProblemType.BiasSrc=1(B), ProblemType.TLUA=False, ProblemType.TLUB=True]
z3_model_output.false_model: [TDMInst=0, BufferLoad=True, AssertFree0ElementMultiple=4, GlobalReadVectorWidthA=1, AssertFree1ElementMultiple=1, GlobalReadVectorWidthB=4, ProblemType.BiasSrc=2(D), ProblemType.TLUA=True, ProblemType.TLUB=False]
z3_model_output.validation: Both Z3 models independently re-evaluated through a pure-Python transcription of the actual source semantics: TRUE model -> True, FALSE model -> False (exact match).

true_examples.why: EdgeType=ShiftPtr (TDMInst=0). BiasSrc=B branch: GuaranteeNoPartialB = (AF1EM%GRVWB==0) = (1%4==0) = False, so (BufferLoad and GNpB)=False, not(...)=True -> enableEdge=True. Predicate True.
EdgeType=ShiftPtr. BiasSrc=A branch: BufferLoad=False so (BufferLoad and GNpA)=False -> enableEdge=True. Predicate True (BufferLoad off path).

false_examples.why: EdgeType=ShiftPtr but BiasSrc=D matches neither the A nor B enableEdge clause -> enableEdge stays False. Predicate False.

TDMInst=3 -> enableTDMA and enableTDMB both True -> EdgeType=None, so first conjunct (EdgeType==ShiftPtr) is False; predicate False regardless of enableEdge (which here would be True). Exercises the EdgeType-override leg.

pure_helper:
def shiftptr_edge_taken(
    tdm_inst: int, buffer_load: bool, af0em: int, grvwa: int,
    af1em: int, grvwb: int, bias_src: str, tlua: bool, tlub: bool,
) -> bool:
    # Pure model of KernelWriterAssembly.py:16798 branch predicate.
    # True iff kernel["EdgeType"]=="ShiftPtr" and enableEdge.
    enable_tdma = bool(tdm_inst & 1)
    enable_tdmb = bool(tdm_inst & 2)
    edge_is_shiftptr = not (enable_tdma and enable_tdmb)
    gnp_a = (af0em % grvwa == 0) if tlua else True
    gnp_b = (af1em % grvwb == 0) if tlub else True
    enable_edge = False
    if not (buffer_load and gnp_a) and bias_src == "A":
        enable_edge = True
    if not (buffer_load and gnp_b) and bias_src == "B":
        enable_edge = True
    return edge_is_shiftptr and enable_edge

crosshair.caveat: Absence of a counterexample is NOT a proof. CrossHair confirms the helper is total (returns a bool, never raises) over the seeded preconditions, corroborating the Z3 result. The domain here is finite and small, so the Z3 SAT witnesses are the load-bearing evidence; CrossHair is a cross-check.

notes: Fully static: predicate reduces to boolean/integer arithmetic over validated YAML solution/problem parameters and two layout-derived bools (TLUA/TLUB). No isinstance, nodeType dispatch, os/filesystem, or GPU probe. Two independent paths set enableEdge (BiasSrc A vs B), each gated by BufferLoad and a GuaranteeNoPartial modulo test (AF*EM % GRVW* == 0); the EdgeType==ShiftPtr conjunct is forced False only when TDMInst sets both TDM bits (=3 in seed). Within the seeded domain the branch is reachable (TRUE) and avoidable (FALSE), both witnessed by Z3 and re-validated by a pure-Python transcription of the source.
